I added `src/payouts/bonus.ts` with `completionBonus(expert, tasksCompleted)`. I haven't compiled it or run it.

It pays $0.75 per completed task and caps the amount at 50, so 67 or more tasks hits the cap. The amount is in dollars, like `hourlyPayout`. The memo reads "Completion bonus for N tasks".

I didn't add any input checks. A negative or fractional `tasksCompleted` goes straight into the calculation, and a negative count would give a negative payout. Say if you want a guard for that.
